summary: Legend Biotech Corp filed a Form 6-K on July 15, 2026, announcing preliminary net trade sales of CARVYKTI of approximately $657 million for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, per data from collaboration partner Janssen. The filing is a routine business update disclosing product sales under the existing collaboration agreement; there are no transaction terms, prices per share, board recommendations, or advisors. It does not signal an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The information is preliminary and unaudited, with a caution regarding forward-looking statements. No special-situation event is triggered; this is a routine operational disclosure.
